The question asks which residue is phosphorylated. Looking at the PDB, there's a residue named "PTR" in chain B at position 201. PTR is the three-letter code for phosphotyrosine. The structure shows it has a P atom and phosphate oxygens (O1P, O2P, O3P), confirming it's phosphorylated.

So the answer is B:Y201 (PTR is phosphotyrosine, one-letter code Y).

The residue identifier format: B:Y201.
